class.name: SlugLabel3D
class.brief_description: Displays sharp, resolution-independent text in a 3D world using the Slug algorithm.
class.description: SlugLabel3D draws text in world space directly from a [SlugFont]'s Bézier glyph outlines, so it stays crisp no matter how large it is on screen or how close the camera gets. This makes it a good choice for signs, billboards, and other large or close-up diegetic text with perspective. It is not meant for dense blocks of small text; use [Label3D] for that instead. [member size] is the world-space size of one em, so a glyph's on-screen size follows [member size] and the camera distance the same way any other 3D object would. SlugLabel3D only works with the GLES3 rendering backend. When running under GLES2, or when [member font] is null or invalid, it falls back to drawing with an internal [Label3D] built from [member fallback_font] if one is set; otherwise nothing is drawn. An outline can be added with [member outline_size] and [member outline_modulate]. Outline pixels outside the glyph cost up to 17 times the fragment work of a plain fill pixel, so keep [member outline_size] no larger than needed. Very thick outlines show small steps at sharp corners. The outline is not drawn in the GLES2/fallback path.

members.member: The horizontal alignment of the text. See [enum Align] for possible values.
If [code]true[/code], the text always faces the camera, matching the camera's rotation instead of the node's.

The [Font] used to draw text through an internal [Label3D] when Slug rendering is unavailable, either because the video driver is GLES2 or because [member font] is null or invalid. If left empty in that situation, nothing is drawn.
The [SlugFont] used to draw the text. Required for Slug rendering; see [member fallback_font] for what happens when it is missing or invalid.
Additional vertical spacing, in world units, added between lines of text.
The color multiplied onto the text's fill.

The color of the outline drawn when [member outline_size] is greater than [code]0[/code]. Also forwarded to the [member fallback_font] path's [member Label3D.outline_modulate], though the fallback only shows an outline if [member fallback_font] itself has one configured.
The width of the outline drawn around each glyph, in em (fractions of [member size]). A value of [code]0[/code] disables the outline. Not applied when falling back to [member fallback_font].
The size, in world units, of one em of text. This is the world-space equivalent of a font's pixel size.
The text to display. Supports multiple lines separated by [code]\n[/code].

constants.constant: Aligns the text to the left.
